cure-time.title: Rubber Cure Time
cure-time.intro: Estimate equivalent cure time from reference temperature/time, activation energy and target temperature. Results are process estimates and do not determine under- or over-cure.

hardness-calc.title: Rubber Hardness Conversion
hardness-calc.intro: Convert Shore A, Shore D and IRHD within stated ranges and estimate elastic modulus. Out-of-range values are marked non-convertible; results are for comparison, not acceptance.

en.title: Rubber Hardness Conversion

mixing-ratio.title: Rubber Mixing Ratio Calculator
mixing-ratio.intro: Calculate ingredient weights from batch weight and phr. Blank, negative and total phr inputs are validated with the same rules for display and copy.

tensile-strength.title: Tensile Strength
tensile-strength.intro: Calculate tensile strength (MPa) and elongation from specimen width, thickness, gauge length and maximum force. Validates load, cross-section and gauge length; results are reference ranges, not a pass/fail verdict.
